exposure: hysteroscopic surgery for cesarean scar diverticulum (CSD)
outcome: correlation between CSD size and severity
correlation between CSD size and pregnancy outcomes
cohort: Patients with CSD who underwent IVF/ICSI-ET at a university-based hospital between January 2017 and July 2023
finding: Patients with moderate-to-severe CSD achieved favorable IVF/ICSI pregnancy outcomes following hysteroscopic surgery.
